adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new sync-aware refresh path calls `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)`. The helper `refreshOAuthTokens`’s third parameter is explicitly `userId: number | null` and is sent as `calcomUserId` to `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`. Passing `credentialId` (inconsistent with other integrations, which pass `credential.userId`) will send the wrong identifier to the sync endpoint, breaking token refresh for Zoho Bigin when the sync flow is enabled.
